mainSection.title: Kickboxing Morocco First Gym of its kind in Agadir.
mainSection.description: Kickboxing Morocco is proud to be the first dedicated kickboxing gym of its kind in Agadir. Built for everyone from complete beginners to seasoned athletes, our well equiped facility offers high-energy training, expert instruction, and a supportive community. Step onto the mats to build strength, learn real technique, and unlock your full potential in a world-class environment.

healthStatus.title: ARTICLE 5: Child Health Status
healthStatus.description: The parent/guardian declares that the child is fit to participate in sports activities and commits to informing the management of KBM GYM AGADIR of any important medical information that could affect the child's safety.

mediaConsent.title: ARTICLE 11: Photos and Videos
mediaConsent.description: KBM GYM AGADIR may take photos/videos during classes and events for parent updates and sports promotion. Please indicate your consent level:

full.label: Full Consent (WhatsApp Group + Social Media & Website)
full.desc: I authorize taking and using photos/videos for the WhatsApp group and general sports promotion of KBM GYM.

whatsapp_only.label: WhatsApp Group Only
whatsapp_only.desc: I only authorize sharing in the private parents' group. No public posts.

none.label: Total Refusal
none.desc: I do not authorize taking or sharing photos and videos of my child.

declaration.title: ARTICLE 14: Declaration and Signature
declaration.summaryHeader: By signing this contract, the parent/guardian acknowledges having:
summaryItems: Read and understood all terms of the contract (Articles 1 to 13).
Acknowledged that membership is strictly annual for the 2026/2027 season.
Accepted the internal regulations, discipline, and schedule adherence (delays > 15 min not allowed).
Provided accurate information regarding the child and their health condition.
declaration.agreeToTermsLabel: I confirm that I have read, understood, and accepted all terms and conditions of this annual membership contract. *
